EXCLUDE USING gist (organization_id WITH =, run_id WITH =, session_id WITH =, tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

CHECK ((((scope = 'organization'::text) AND (department_id IS NULL) AND (employee_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope = 'department'::text) AND (department_id IS NOT NULL) AND (employee_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope = 'employee'::text) AND (employee_id IS NOT NULL) AND (department_id IS NULL))))

FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, employee_id) REFERENCES workpulse.employees(organization_id, id)
EXCLUDE USING gist (organization_id WITH =, scope WITH =, COALESCE(department_id, employee_id, organization_id) WITH =, tstzrange(valid_from, valid_until, '[)'::text) WITH &&)
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, requested_by) REFERENCES workpulse.user_accounts(organization_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, run_id) REFERENCES workpulse.analytics_runs(organization_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, department_id) REFERENCES workpulse.departments(organization_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, user_id) REFERENCES workpulse.user_accounts(organization_id, id)
UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (organization_id, user_id, role_code, scope, department_id)
CHECK ((((NOT ends_next_day) AND (ends_at > starts_at)) OR (ends_next_day AND (ends_at <= starts_at))))
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, session_id) REFERENCES workpulse.work_sessions(organization_id, id)
EXCLUDE USING gist (organization_id WITH =, session_id WITH =, tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)
